text:
Type:        ROLLUP
Name:        Rollup
Category:    transformers
Description: Receives data through connected input port, groups incoming records by their key values and lets user transformation arbitrarily create new data records from the group by aggregating, composing or splitting. Sends these new data records through the connected output port(s) as specified by the transformation. Rollup function is superset for (De)Normalizer components.
Usage:       When to use: Custom group processing logic that AGGREGATE can't express — e.g. conditional aggregation, producing multiple output records per group, or accumulating complex state. Full CTL2 control via initGroup/updateGroup/finishGroup/transform functions.
             Constraints: Requires CTL2 code. Input must be sorted on groupKeyFields by default.
             More complex to write than AGGREGATE. Use AGGREGATE if built-in aggregation functions cover the need.

Input Ports:
  [0] (required)
Output Ports:
  [*] (min 1 required)

Properties:
  Conditional required groups:
    transform | transformClassName | transformUrl (at least one is required; mutually exclusive)

  groupKeyFields: [key]  Defines the key fields used for group key.
  groupAccumulatorMetadataId: [metadata]  Configures group accumulator.
  transform [attr-cdata]: [transformRollup]  Defines the transformation logic used to convert input records to output records.
  transformUrl: [file]  Specifies the path or URL for transform url.
  transformClassName: [class]  Configures transform class.
  transformUrlCharset: [charset]  Specifies the path or URL for transform source charset.
  inputSorted: [bool]  (default: true)  When enabled, controls sorted input of the component.
  equalNULL: [bool]  (default: true)  Controls whether NULL values are considered equal when identifying duplicates.

To configure it, call component_get_guide("ROLLUP") — full attribute reference with allowed values, defaults, and worked mapping/transform examples this surface view omits. Don't re-run component_get_info on the same type; if the properties above aren't enough, escalate to component_get_guide.
